sourcePolicy: 2026/27 club/manufacturer materials and official first-team match kit reports. Exact colours remain simplified when mapped into the original SWOS palette; research never edits TEAM.* automatically.

clubs.description: Red body with white sleeves
clubs.note: The official 2026/27 launch depicts the red-and-white home identity. SWOS contrast-sleeve rendering is an approximation; shorts and socks not assessed.

clubs.description: Deep red with geometric tonal print
clubs.note: SWOS Brown approximates deep Active Maroon; game cannot render the 1989-inspired geometric shirt motif.

clubs.description: Claret shirt; glow-blue shorts and socks
clubs.note: SWOS Brown and Light blue are nearest palette entries, not exact claret or glow blue. Shirt construction is simplified.

clubs.description: Gradient sky-blue shirt
clubs.note: SWOS Light blue looks different from the actual sky-blue gradient and cannot render a gradient. Shorts/socks need checking.

clubs.description: Red shirt with white-and-black collar details
clubs.note: Official 2026/27 shop offers black and white home shorts and socks. No fixed selection without checking first-team match kit; trim is not representable.

clubs.description: Bright blue shirt with gold details
clubs.note: The club describes blue home shirt and shorts with gold details and white socks. SWOS cannot display gold accents.

clubs.description: Disrupted black-and-white vertical stripes
clubs.note: Black/white stripe base, black shorts and black socks sourced from the club. SWOS standard stripes cannot mimic the disrupted pattern or blue neck detail.

clubs.description: White shirt with navy trim; navy shorts, white socks
clubs.note: Official match report confirms lilywhite shirts, navy shorts and white socks. SWOS Black is only a proxy for unavailable dark navy.

clubs.description: Blue home shirt with white trim
clubs.note: Official Castore 2026/27 shirt is blue; shorts and socks have not been individually verified in this pass.

clubs.description: Wide red-and-black vertical stripes
clubs.note: Club store describes wider 2026/27 stripes; SWOS vertical stripes simplify their spacing and crest pattern. Shorts/socks not yet verified.

clubs.description: Royal blue shirt with fine white pinstripes
clubs.note: The 2026/27 Brighton shirt is predominantly royal blue with thin white pinstripes; SWOS cannot render fine pinstripes, so choose plain blue rather than broad stripes.

clubs.description: White home shirt with accent details
clubs.note: Leeds official 2026/27 home kit is the traditional white. Shorts/socks and fine shirt detailing await explicit match evidence.

clubs.description: Red-and-white stripes; black shorts and socks
clubs.note: Spurs' 20 August 2026 match report explicitly confirms the Brentford kit including shorts and socks.

clubs.description: Red shirt; white shorts and red socks
clubs.note: Spurs' 3 September 2026 match report explicitly confirms Forest's home shirt, shorts and socks.

clubs.description: White shirt with red-and-blue diagonal sash
clubs.note: The 2026/27 sash design has a white base and red/blue diagonal band; no SWOS shirt pattern supports a diagonal sash. White is a deliberate simplified proxy; shorts/socks still need match evidence.

clubs.description: White shirt with black and red trim
clubs.note: Official 26/27 Fulham launch confirms this season's shirt, with colour supported by current adidas home product listing; SWOS cannot reproduce collar/shoulder trim or subtle fabric graphics. Shorts and socks not verified.

clubs.description: Deeper sky blue with fine navy-striped jacquard; navy shorts, blue socks
clubs.note: Official complete-kit description confirms navy shorts and royal blue socks. Light blue shirt, black-as-navy shorts and royal-blue socks approximate the palette. Fine blue-on-blue stripes and pinstripes cannot be represented.

clubs.description: Amber and black vertical stripes with white collar
clubs.note: Club's 2026/27 Oxen home shirt is amber and black striped; exact collar and historical HCAFC motif cannot be recreated. Full first-team shorts/socks awaiting an explicitly verified source.

clubs.description: Blue embossed shirt; white shorts and blue socks
clubs.note: Official 3 July kit reveal confirms shirt, white home shorts and blue socks. SWOS plain blue omits the embossed Portman Road floodlight-roof motif and navy trim.

clubs.description: Red and white vertical stripes; 1937-inspired detail
clubs.note: Official hummel product confirms red-white striped 2026/27 home shirt. SWOS stripes omit the trophy-inspired jacquard, polo collar and shoulder chevrons. Shorts/socks unverified.

clubs.description: Royal blue home shirt with city-inspired detail
clubs.note: Birmingham City's official 2026/27 home-kit launch uses the blue home identity; exact graphics and shorts/socks still need a separate manufacturer or match-day check.

clubs.description: Blue and white halved home shirt
clubs.note: Club's official Umbro 26/27 launch confirms blue-and-white home identity. SWOS cannot create the shirt's split-halves design; plain blue is a conservative base rather than an exact representation. Shorts/socks unverified.

clubs.description: All-white home strip with red and navy sleeve detailing
clubs.note: Official 29 May 2026 launch explicitly says white from collar to sock. Plain white SWOS kit cannot show the sublimated red/navy right-sleeve insert.

clubs.description: Claret-and-blue textured home shirt
clubs.note: Official 2026/27 kit product specifies claret and blue and textured stripe jacquard. SWOS claret/brown is a limited palette approximation. No independent shorts/socks colours confirmed.

clubs.description: Royal blue home shirt with white accents
clubs.note: Official Castore 26/27 home shirt in club shop confirms this season's design; plain SWOS blue omits white sleeve/shoulder detailing. Shorts/socks need separate verification.

clubs.description: Red home shirt and white home shorts
clubs.note: Official 2026/27 club collection stocks red home shirt and white home shorts. Shirt accents and home sock colour still need a dated kit source; socks deliberately unfilled.

clubs.description: White shirt with six narrow greyscale stripes; black shorts, white socks
clubs.note: Official Derby County 28 May 2026 release confirms all three kit components. Six centred fine greyscale pinstripes are not reproducible as SWOS broad stripes; white shirt is intentionally simplified.

clubs.description: Red and white stripes with Lincoln Castle arch detailing
clubs.note: Club's own 2026/27 kit announcement confirms red and white stripes and black trim. SWOS cannot render Castle arches within stripes. Shorts/socks remain unverified.

clubs.description: Red 150th-anniversary shirt with gold trim
clubs.note: Official 2026/27 Castore 150 Years home shirt is red with gold detailing; SWOS has no gold trim. Shorts and socks await first-team match evidence.
